description:
Make `jit validate <id>`, the rule report without an id and `jit validate <id> --explain` capture the repository once, compute the one report from the records the capture parsed, and select from it.

## Background

- `run_rules` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:1575-1693`) and `explain_rules` (`:1930-2022`) read through storage and the executor's disk caches, evaluate graph rules over every issue, call the executor-side dangling-link and drift passes, and capture a whole validation image only to read plan documents (`image_plan_content`, `:1545-1554`). Per-issue validation takes about three times as long as whole-repository validation on this repository.
- Today's per-issue filter keeps every configuration error of a rule whose selector matches the issue, whoever fired it (`:1653-1657`), and folds in drift only when the rule set is unloadable (`:1589-1611`); explain keeps every configuration error (`:1964-1968`).
- The validation capture returns a `CapturedValidation` with the records it parsed. Whole-repository validation also derives the divergence view and the claims-index input; the issue selection excludes the structural failure.
- `run_rules` and `explain_rules` keep their signatures; callers include `main.rs` (the validate arm), `commands/batch_create.rs:967`, `commands/gate_check.rs:2839,3042`, `tests/fast_docs_templates/batch_export_tests.rs:411`, `tests/fast_issue/short_hash_tests.rs:293,302` and `tests/fast_rules/default_rules_registry_derivation_tests.rs:167`.
- Tests that re-prove filtering: `commands/validate.rs:3336,3365,3388`; `tests/fast_rules/validate_rule_runner_tests.rs:94,108,137`; `tests/cli_item_validate/validate_cli_rule_tests.rs:692,715`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `run_rules(Some(id))` is the report's issue selection, `run_rules(None)` its whole selection, and `explain_rules` its explanation, each computed from one validation capture whose parsed records the report reads; none reads storage, the executor's caches or a second capture.
- [hard] REQ-02: The per-issue and explain paths derive no divergence view and read no claims index, so their work is a subset of whole-repository validation's.
- [hard] REQ-03: Harness tests show that `jit validate <id>` omits a `container-from-label` pointer error fired by another issue under a rule matching the selected issue, and that with an unloadable rule set and an invariant bound to a rule it reports `rules-file` and no `enforcement-drift`; each fails on today's code, whose per-issue filter keeps the pointer error and reports drift.
- [hard] REQ-04: The listed filtering tests are reduced to wiring (the view equals the report's selection) or removed where the selection tests own the property; the CLI output and exit-code tests pass unchanged.

## Notes

- Behaviour change: per-issue and explain configuration errors narrow to the selected issue's subject or rule; `rules-file` is always included and `enforcement-drift` never.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Per-issue and explain validation select from the report
